notablePrerequisites:
Savage Ventmaw does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Savage Ventmaw and Hellkite Charger.
description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and Savage Ventmaw as attackers.Druids' Repository's first ability triggers twice, and Savage Ventmaw and Hellkite Charger trigger once.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve both Druid's Repository triggers, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Druid's Repository by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
